title: The survey record of an audit: what every page of the book holds (mcprep audit gate --survey FILE or FOLDER)
description: A JSON list of RANGES of pages, written by whoever looked at every page of the book (an object { "survey": [...] } is accepted too). Pages are zero-based and the range is inclusive: { "from": 0, "to": 17, "kind": "front" } says that pages 0 to 17 are front matter. Every page of the book has exactly one entry. --survey may name a FOLDER instead of a file: every .json file in it (sheets.json is skipped) is such a list, and the lists are merged in the order of the file names, numbers compared as numbers (overview-2 before overview-10), so that one small file can be written for each overview picture. The gate checks the record against the project and needs no knowledge of the layout: an entry that is not in the format is open as survey-range, a page without an entry as survey-missing (one finding names the first ranges), a page in two entries as survey-overlap, a page marked exercises or both that no exercise region touches (an exercise's own region or one of its continuations; an instruction does not count) or a page marked answers or both that no solution region touches as survey-uncovered, and a page that an exercise region touches but the record marks as text, blank, front, back or answers (or that a solution region touches but the record marks as text, blank, front, back or exercises) as survey-unmarked. None of these can be acknowledged: repair the project or the record. Plain JSON, camelCase.

from.description: The first page of the range (zero-based, 0 is the first page of the PDF). Not after `to`; inside the book.

to.description: The last page of the range (inclusive; the same as `from` for one page). Inside the book.

kind.description: What the pages hold. exercises: at least one exercise or part of one (a set at the end of a section, or exercises inline in the text). answers: answers or worked solutions of exercises, and no exercise. both: exercises and answers. text: exposition, worked examples, figures, no exercise of the book. blank: empty, a divider, a picture only. front: title, copyright, preface, contents. back: index, bibliography, glossary, appendices that are neither exercises nor answers.

note.description: Optional: a few words for the next reader (at most 120 characters).
